zh: 由左到右是 KP01 到 KP05，每個知識點下方是它留下的問題，也是下一個知識點的出發點。先順著箭頭讀，再回頭看每一格的名稱。〔功能：1〕
全章路線圖：KP01 一條線不夠、KP02 先編碼再分類、KP03 編碼與極限、KP04 逐碼偵測、KP05 從點長網路，每個知識點留下的問題接到下一個。
en: From left to right are KP01 to KP05, with the question each KP leaves over below it, which is the starting point of the next KP. Follow the arrows first, then look back at the name of each box. [Function: 1]

Roadmap of the chapter: KP01 one line is not enough, KP02 encode first then classify, KP03 codes and limits, KP04 detect code by code, KP05 grow a network from points; the question each leaves over leads to the next.
